bias.en: Bearish · back on the Sep 3 low and 200-day
bias.zh: 偏空 · 回到 9 月 3 日低点和 200 日均线

read.en: Arm fell 6.9% on Oct 16 to $227.80, giving back the previous day's rebound, and is down 14.5% over five sessions. It is below the 5-day ($244.3), 10-day ($266.3), 30-day ($276.6) and falling 100-day ($295.2) averages and just above the rising 200-day ($223.4). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 7 and below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Sep 28 ($290.5), and RSI is 34.5.
read.zh: Arm 10月16日下跌 6.9%，收于 $227.80，回吐前一日反弹，五个交易日累计下跌 14.5%。股价位于 5 日（$244.3）、10 日（$266.3）、30 日（$276.6）和下行的 100 日均线（$295.2）下方，略高于上行的 200 日均线（$223.4）。MACD 自 10月7日起位于信号线下方并在零轴之下，抛物线 SAR 自 9月28日起看空（$290.5），RSI 为 34.5。

read.en: The $237.5 support reclaimed on Oct 15 broke on the close and is now resistance; the day's low of $226.65 held the $225.5–226.5 zone (Sep 3 and Oct 15 lows). Resistance is $237.5–239.4, then $244.3–244.8 (5-day average, Oct 15 close) and $266 (10-day). Support is $225.5–226.5, then $223.4 (200-day) and $219.4 (Aug 3 low). A close below $223.4 would open $219.4.

r.en: Support since July, now resistance; Oct 16 high $239.4
r.zh: 7月以来的支撑，转为阻力；10月16日高点 $239.4
